d: Ash-blonde, shoulder-length hair with blunt bangs and a soft texture. Pale mint-green eyes with a gentle, smiling expression. An adolescent appearance with a slender build. A dark brown beret, a navy blue and green plaid capelet over a white collared shirt, a dark brown utility belt with a small side pouch, and shiny charcoal-grey trousers tucked into mustard-yellow diamond-patterned socks and tan lace-up boots. Accessories include yellow leather gloves, a tool belt filled with metallic instruments, and a large, complex scientific apparatus carried on the back featuring glass vials and metallic machinery.
